metas.name: Power Games: The Packer-Murdoch Story
metas.description:
Drama de rivalidades mediáticas y ambición corporativa.

The making of modern Australia through the eyes of competing media moguls Sir Frank Packer and a young Rupert Murdoch.

metas.name: The Bible
metas.description:
Drama histórico en formato de miniserie sobre relatos épicos.

Miniserie de 10 horas de duración que narra la historia del cristianismo desde el Antiguo hasta el Nuevo testamento. Se describen algunas de las historias más conocidas de las sagradas escrituras, desde el Génesis hasta el Apocalipsis, incluyendo el relato del arca de Noé, el Éxodo y la vida de Jesús de Nazaret.

metas.name: St. Elsewhere
metas.description:
Drama médico clásico de los 80s con elencos corales.

St. Elsewhere is an American medical drama television series that originally ran on NBC from October 26, 1982 to May 25, 1988. The series starred Ed Flanders, Norman Lloyd and William Daniels as teaching doctors at a lightly-regarded Boston hospital who gave interns a promising future in making critical medical and life decisions.

metas.name: Jude the Obscure
metas.description:
Drama británico de época sobre superación y tragedia.

Jude the Obscure is a British television serial directed by Hugh David and dramatised by Harry Green, based on Thomas Hardy's 1895 novel of the same name.

Born into poverty, young Jude Fawley refuses to accept his lot in life. As his dreams are shattered one by one, his life gradually descends into tragedy.

metas.name: Mastermind of Murder
metas.description:
Serie documental sobre crímenes verdaderos y mentes criminales.

The best way to get away with murder is to have someone else do it for you, which is why the most cunning killers never lay a finger on their victims. In these cases love, loyalty, faith, and family become dangerous weapons, and the most vicious criminal isn't the one who pulled the trigger--it's the one who pulled their strings.

metas.name: Dateline
metas.description:
Documental policiaco de larga trayectoria enfocado en crímenes reales.

Dateline NBC, or simply Dateline, is a weekly American television newsmagazine series. It was previously the network's flagship newsmagazine, but now focuses mainly on true crime stories with only occasional editions that focus on other topics.

metas.name: Close Enough
metas.description:
Se sale un poco de tu patrón habitual, pero tiene suficientes puntos en común para que valga la pena probarla.

Una pareja casada millennial, que tienen poco más de treinta años, intentan no perder la onda mientras hacen malabarismos con desafíos cotidianos como la paternidad, la amistad, el robo de jamones, los payasos strippers y la elección de la guardería adecuada.

metas.name: Drongo
metas.description: Mini misterio criminal de principios de los 2000.

metas.name: Uncle
metas.description:
Comedia británica sobre un músico inmaduro cuidando a su sobrino.

Andy is a dissolute out-of work musician who forges an unlikely alliance with his 12-year-old nephew Errol after being morally blackmailed into looking after him by his chaotic sister Sam - all on the day Andy was planning to kill himself. Not a natural with either kids or responsibility, he tries to keep his new charge out of trouble while being knee-deep in it himself.

metas.name: Real Rob
metas.description:
Comedia de estilo autobiográfico de vida cotidiana.

El actor y comediante Rob Schneiderhace una mezcla exagerada de los altibajos de su vida profesional y personal.

metas.name: Dream On
metas.description:
Comedia noventera con humor adulto sobre la vida amorosa.

The family life, romantic life, and career of Martin Tupper, a divorced New York City book editor. The show distinctively interjected clips from older black and white television series to punctuate Tupper's feelings or thoughts.

metas.name: Tyler Perry's House of Payne
metas.description:
Sitcom familiar tradicional con momentos dramáticos.

A multigenerational, working-class family experience life's struggles with faith, love and, most importantly, humor. Curtis, aka 'Pops', the uncle and head of the household, has house and home turned upside down when an unexpected event forces his nephew, CJ, and CJ’s kids to move in, putting three generations under one roof. This chaotic living situation takes its toll on cranky Pops, who is reluctant to have his routine disturbed. In addition to CJ’s family, Pops and Ella’s son, Calvin, a wise-cracking, broke college student, hangs out at home, making it impossible for any peace and quiet. It soon becomes evident just how wide the gap is, as the family tries to find a way to coexist through all of life’s hilarious ups and downs.

metas.name: We Own This City
metas.description:
Se sale un poco de tu patrón habitual, pero tiene suficientes puntos en común para que valga la pena probarla.

Crónica del auge y caída del GTTF, el cuerpo especial de la policía de Baltimore dedicado a rastrear armas, una unidad corrupta que habitualmente cometía delitos de fraude, extorsión y reventa de drogas previamente confiscadas.

metas.name: Instant Mom
metas.description:
Comedia ligera sobre asumir la maternidad de golpe.

Martini Mondays and tequila Tuesdays take a back seat to new step-motherhood when former party girl Stephanie marries Charlie, an older dad with three kids. Becoming an instant mom doesn't come with a rulebook, but it does come with a dose of humor as Stephanie traverses the fine line between being a friend and being a responsible parent.

metas.name: Son of the Beach
metas.description:
Parodia cómica absurda de los años 2000.

A parody of "Baywatch" featuring Malibu Adjacent's Notch Johnson, the world's greatest lifeguard (hardly), and his unit SPF-30.

metas.name: Brass Eye
metas.description:
Comedia británica satírica noventera con humor negro absurdo.

Investigative reporter Chris Morris puts modern Britain under the spotlight, and smacks the issues of the day till they bleed. He tackles weighty issues including animals, drugs, sex and skewered celebrities and politicians alike - and in a later episode in 2001, paedophiles.

metas.name: Baskets
metas.description:
Comedia excéntrica sobre un payaso profesional y su peculiar familia.

Chip Baskets wants to follow his dream of being a French clown—however, reality keeps interfering. Saddled with financial difficulties and facing an impenetrable language barrier, he moves back home to Bakersfield with high hopes. There, he is forced to confront his past while working as a rodeo clown and competing with his siblings for his mother's approval and affection.

metas.name: King of the Hill
metas.description:
Comedia animada sobre la vida familiar con humor cotidiano.

Los reyes de la colina muestra la vida de la típica familia tejana, los Hills, conservadores, orgullosos de sus orígenes tejanos, temerosos del poder de Dios... Serie de televisión de culto emitida por FOX, la segunda más lóngeva de la cadena después de Los Simpson (casi 300 capítulos), creada por Mike Judge (Beavis and Butthead) y por Greg Daniels (guionista de Los Simpson).

metas.name: The Cuphead Show!
metas.description:
Animación de comedia física y aventuras ligeras.

No te pierdas las desventuras de nuestro impulsivo héroe y de su precavido pero fiel hermano en esta serie animada basada en el exitoso videojuego.

metas.name: Kenan & Kel
metas.description:
Se sale un poco de tu patrón habitual, pero tiene suficientes puntos en común para que valga la pena probarla.

Kenan y Kel, dos mejores amigos que viven en Chicago, siempre se ven arrastrados por los planes de Kenan para hacerse rico de la noche a la mañana; Kel, el amigo al que le encanta la gaseosa de naranja, se deja llevar, pero suele estropearlo todo.
